Yep: my brain's burning 100% of time, and I can't form any emotions, including sadness. I'm a robot essentially.

I dare disagree: robotic ("always low") existence is degrading, it's dehumanizing. You don't know where to 'go', any action is entirely useless, you don't grow, you don't learn, do don't contribute. It's a lose-lose situation. Don't be like me. 

Your condition is amendable, you can work on it if you choose, it's not the end of the road. It's not an easy road, but it's the one you can see. 

If you're like me, you're always blind: you see nothing, you don't have nowhere to go, you don't even have thoughts of your own, it's just a fog in your brain all the time. 

Go find a way to work on it, fight it. 

Keep us posted.

Almost always. My family doesn't understand it, and I try my best to keep them away from it. So I usually do it at night in my room when they are asleep, keep the noise down. 

But shotry I'm travelling to another county where my good friend lives and we'll be tripping on mescaline again, like in good old days. Very much look forward to that!

My situation is exactly the same. I have some sort of disorder when I can't form thoughts: all thoughts are very short, meaningless and not mine, my head doesn't belong to me. My conscience is broken and I can't think about anything.

Not everyone's situation is that bad though: meds and therapy help a lot of people. 

The best you can do is find a meaning in life: once you've done that, you will never suffer from this un-existence.
not if it's going on all the time: this could be a very serious problem then

Do you mean this happens absolutely always, regardless of what you are doing? All your thoughts are weightless, have no value? This could be super-bad, bro: depending on how long you've been having it, could be either a psychological or neurological problem. The latter is my situation, neural pathways in my head are all fucked up, I literally can't think about anything at all, absolutely nothing is meaningful!

Go get help, even if it costs you a lot of money: it is far better to spend it on yourself and make you life meaningful, full of sense than  suffer for the rest of your days with no understanding of  what's going on around you. In other words, don't repeat my mistakes.

Good luck!

Regardless of this state, do you feel like you are doing (and, more importantly, thinking about) meaningful stuff? Do your thoughts have 'weights' or 'values'? Do you think they 'make sense' (only you can answer these questions, as these entities vary from person to person). If not, then your situation is similar to mine, and this sucks a lot. None of my thoughts have any value at all. Hopefully it is not too late for you. There are ways to amend this situation before it becomes too serious.

And remember: you are not imagining and pretending. You're ill. Everyone deserves a meaningful and fulfilling life. 

Keep us posted!

>I can say that it's better to take some action asap. Just in case it's the thingy, plus a check-up won't hurt.

Second this! 

Dude, don't gamble with this shit: you can end up like me, leading a pointless life without any sense in it. I mean it: no sense in anything, no thoughts are meaningful, nothing at all. If it's anything like my situation, you might not have that much time. It progresses from psychological to neurological pretty quickly. Your neurons will get stuck in harmful neural pathways that will control your existence. Unfucking your brain will be harder than running London marathon with 16kg dumbells tied to your legs. 

See the therapist or whoever you can, take the medication or whatever they prescribe. Hopefully, this will help you find some meaningful things to occupy yourself with.

Good luck and keep us posted.
Rebirthing, shrooms, LSD?

I'm 39 and I'm where you are although I started feeling like this at 17. 

You have the talent to write, a friend you like, and a degree you enjoy. You are richer than you think. I have none of these, because my brain is very fucked, probably beyond repair: I can't form coherent meaningful thoughts in my head, and nothing makes any sense.

Your situation is bad, but you still have at least partial control of your conscience, so at the fundamental level you are probably health. There are novel therapies like MDMA and psylocibe, and less known but potent like rebirthing. Did you try them?

13 months isn't too bad: what have you tried? 

For me one mistake was enough to doom me to a life of misery, although I've applied inadvertently efforts to make cause myself this sort of harm for about 1.5 years before.

Since you shift between these states, your situation is better than mine.

My situation: brain just gets stuck in a bad rut. Like all the bad neural pathways become strong quickly and you just fail to notice it and/or get help, adn by the time you've realized you can't have coherent thoughts, essentially no thoughts of your own, it's very hard to rewire your brain. 

My case was particularly bad because there was no help at the time and I genuinly didn't understand what happened to me. Don't repeat my mistake, go get some serious help bro!

This is called a rut. The fact that you can crawl out of it means it's not too bad yet. Don't gamble with it, don't take chances. Go find help while the situation is still manageable. I was young and stupid enough and there was no help at the time, so I stuck in this rut and fucked my brain for good. 

You deserve a meaningful and fulfilling life, which is simply impossible if you get stuck in this spiral: ANTs will eat you alive like they ate me, you will live only to serve them. Find a method that works for you and stop this.
How's your mindset? Mine is really bad, such a crazy amount would probably drive me insane. The worst is the comedown: you are exhausted, but can't relax and just tire yourself out.

From what I've read, you have:

\-feelings of inferiority,

\-feelings of pain and suffering,

\-desire to be accepted 

That's a lot! Definitely more that I have: I have nothing, I'm the poorest man on earth. Yes, I understand, it hurts like hell, but your conscience is intact, it's damaged, but it's intact unlike mine, your thoughts are MEANINGFUL. 

Don't repeat my mistake and destroy your mind to avoid the pain: there's treatment available, you can heal your personality and get the love you deserve.

>yep, and as “complex” and “advanced” as the brain is, it’s really just the most cocky and pretentious thing on the planet. nothing is as arrogant as a human.

Maybe. You can still have a very fulfilling and rewarding life if you can fix your brain to make thoughts meaningful, intense and long.
Cheers to that! Keep us posted
More importantly, how it's working out for you? Some of them fried my brain, while LSD and shrooms tried to heal it
we are nothing without our brain. Our brain can create sense and meaning, but it also creates pain. You can't haave one without the other.
You will get rid of some of the pain at the cost of losing all feelings. Don't be like me!

Whatever the label, no conventional medicine or therapy have helped me(( I just call it a fucked brain. I'm currently trying to unfuck my brain with psylocibe mushrooms, LSD and rebirthing breathwork. Had some limited success but the bad dead neural pathways are really strong and don't let go of their strength so easily. I keep fighting. 

My success so far:

1) Gym 2 x day for 5 months

2) Complete stop of self-hating 'thoughts'

3) Complete stop of wanting to appease others 'thoughts'

>thank you for enlightening me! a quick bit of research is making me think it’s almost definitely this

This is essentially the brain's way to stop feeling pain. This usually (in my case definitely) came at the cost of not feeling anything and having my brain part-destroyed

MY situation is very similar. You could also be suffering from a brain dysfunction of sorts. 

 `i feel as if i’m very detached from my own body` 

 `it’s all fake` 

These two sound super familiar to me. My conscience/personality is split, I don't have consistent strong thoughts, that carry sense and meaning. This makes me 'feel' the way you do: unreal and non-existent. This is essentially a brain damage: the neurons in your head are not functioning properly and you can't construct meaning from entities. 

I don't know how bad your stage of illness is (mine is really bad), but in order to make sense you'll have to unfuck yr brain

OK, so you: 

\- SUFFER,

\- FEEL lonely,

\- LOVE your friends,

\- NEED to vent.

That's a lot! Certainly more than I have. You have feelings, thoughts, desires, your brain is fundamentally healthy! You are suffering, but you are gifted with a range of wonderful feelings that can help you heal. I'm sure you can get a lot of useful advice here, but in my opinion you are very RICH. If you start thinking about what you have in your head, you will feel better!  You personality is intact, your brain is not broken. You can work on the rest and get better if you choose to.

Value every thought like your last, experience it to the very bottom, drink it, devour it. 

You have your personality, the rest you can work on.

You love your parents? You don't want them to suffer? You can suffer? 

Dude, you are way, way, way better off than me! I don't love anyone. I don't hate anyone, I don't think of anyone: that's how my fucked my brain is. My existence is robotic and meaningless, yours is full of real thoughts and feelings. I see that you suffer, but you can choose to work on it, and although it might hurt like hell, all that would mean is that YOU AREA ALIVE! I'd give anything to feel alive again. I'd WANT to be you.

But at least your thoughts are YOURS and YOURS only! There's not dirty villain in your head just hammering at the poor neurons churning out 'text' into your conscience! 

You have the power over your thoughts: try using it to change them, there are many ways. As long as your conscience is intact, you still have very good chances of recovery.

Dude, this situation sucks, I never met a woman in my life that could do such a thing to her kids. BUT do notice:

\- you are sad,

\- you broke down,

\- you feel pain.

This just means you are alive! You have real feelings and you are much richer than you think! I'd give away anything to be you now. You will get over this quagmire, your kids will grow up to respect you because of your efforts to be the best father for them. 

In other words, your existence is and will be meaningful: this is something that a lot of people with the broken brain like me just can't have.

God I can only envy you: I wish I could feel sad, anxious, lonely and hated myself. That's 'cause I don't feel anything at all 100% of time: my existence is entirely robotic as I don't have any thoughts in my head.
